title: Salary day reminder
summary: A few days before salaries are due each month, remind the owner on WhatsApp or Telegram and the accountant by email.
description: On the day of the month you choose, tells the owner and emails the accountant that salaries are due soon, so the account can be funded and the payroll checked in time. The owner hears on the WhatsApp or Telegram they linked to Taskiem (or by email); the accountant's email is the tenant variable accountant_email.

params.name: day_of_month
params.title: Reminder day
params.description: The day of the month the reminder goes out (1 to 28).

params.name: payday
params.title: Payday
params.description: When salaries are paid, as you would say it.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the reminder goes out, Lagos time.

params.name: gmail_connection
params.title: Gmail connection
params.description: The mailbox the email is sent from.

steps.name: Remind the owner and the accountant

input.message: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ': salaries are due on ' + steps.settings.output.payday + '. Please fund the salary account and confirm the payroll.'

input.subject: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ': payroll due ' + steps.settings.output.payday
input.text:
='Hello,

Salaries at ' + steps.settings.output.business_name + ' are due on ' + steps.settings.output.payday + '. Please prepare the payroll and confirm the totals with the owner.

Thank you.'
